citation.authors: Docherty S, Doughty FL, Smith EF

cited_by.title: Lion's mane and reishi mushroom supplements

record.population: Healthy adults aged 18 to 45 (country not stated in the abstract)
record.design: Randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled pilot of 1.8 g lion's mane, one dose and then 28 days
record.finding: One dose was followed by faster Stroop task performance at 60 minutes. A trend to lower self-rated stress after 28 days did not reach significance (p = 0.051). The authors say null and limited findings were also seen and call for larger studies.
record.note: A pilot. Ethnicity not reported in the abstract.
